input: Scheduled routine: continue work on the repo aiming to develop, deploy, market, sell and support revenue generating software products in production (owner's standing ventures brief).
task: Deepen (flagship 13) xer-schedule-check: Gantt grouped by activity code

doc_friction.issue: A command group like `cd X && (long cmd > log) & next` runs the cd inside the backgrounded group only, so the next command ran in the old cwd; minor, my own shell slip, not a doc error.

Start-here row changepoint-detector had 31 run records in 2 days; the pick by session id among the first 6 rows keeps sending runs to the most-worked flagship. A rows-worked-recently penalty would spread runs better.

deviations.why: Start here named changepoint-detector (row 2), whose next: items are mostly statistical rounds already worked by 31 runs in two days; took row 8 xer-schedule-check, whose next: named a buildable user-facing item (Gantt grouping by activity code) with no open PR.
deviations.did: Claimed xer-schedule-check with draft PR #17993 and claim_check (HOLD), shipped the grouping.
deviations.result: Landed in one run: feature, page, CLI, tests and eval.

goal: Let subcontractors, owners and lenders without a P6 seat group an XER's Gantt by activity code, as P6's Group and Sort does.
notes: Verification: node --test via run_venture_tests.py xer-schedule-check: 211 tests ok + site page checks ok. eval/activity-codes-check.mjs on 4 public P6 files with codes (92 charts): once 92/92, place 1,239,716/1,239,716, count, tally 943/943, rollup, order all pass; three mutants (order reversed, nested parents dropped, counts off by one) each fail. Browser check with Playwright on the hotel file: Group by selects filled from the file's 5 code types, Responsibility then WBS chart drawn, no console errors. venture-preflight run before merge (see PR). No agent doc in docs/reports: the eval write-up and README carry what the next run needs.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: a senior JS developer with P6 knowledge: code-table reader, grouping tree, page/CLI wiring, tests, an independent eval and write-ups, about 10 h

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
CI minutes and the reviewer bots' own model calls
